Do thy have to pray in musjid or eidgah? In wht case, cn she pray at hme? Question: Assalamoalaikum. Wht is d ruling of eid salaat 4 women? Is it wajib, or sunna? Do thy have to pray in musjid or eidgah? In wht case, cn she pray at hme? Answer ID: 14376 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1097/1097=M/1430) The women are not asked to perform the Salah of Eid; neither it is sunnah nor wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
